safety_protocols.title: Site Safety
safety_protocols.content: Always wear appropriate safety equipment. Be aware of site hazards.

safety_protocols.title: Weather Conditions
safety_protocols.content: Check weather forecast. Secure equipment in case of severe weather.

safety_protocols.title: Emergency Procedures
safety_protocols.content: Know emergency contact numbers. Have first aid kit accessible.

safety_protocols.title: Team Communication
safety_protocols.content: Maintain regular check-ins. Share location with team members.
